SEVERITY: 0.90

FIND: The `finding_by_id` dictionary comprehension silently drops duplicate findings with the same `finding_id`. This causes feedback to be misrouted or lost when multiple models submit the same finding ID.
FOLLOW: When `finding_by_id` overwrites previous entries, any feedback (refutations, admissibility failures, duplicates, R_k discrepancies) for the overwritten models is lost. The feedback is only associated with the last model that submitted the finding ID. This breaks the core feedback loop for any model whose finding ID collided.
ANALYSE: CONFIRMED. HARD constraint violation (data loss / incorrect feedback routing). The comprehension `{f.finding_id: f for f in findings}` inherently keeps only the last element for each key.
